data.name: Areen
data.gender_notes: Areen is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'aruna', which means 'dawn' or 'radiant'. In Hindu mythology, Aruna is the charioteer of the sun god Surya. This name signifies a bright, shining, and enlightened individual. The name Areen carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Areen usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Areen belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, Shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Areen total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
